name: Main Ridge Dairy
address: 295 Main Creek Rd, Main Ridge VIC 3928
signature: A working farmhouse goat dairy on the Main Ridge, farm-made cheeses, goat-milk gelato, and a café with views across the paddocks to the herd.
editorNote:
Main Ridge Dairy is a working farmhouse goat dairy that has built a small but devoted following for its farm-made cheeses and, more recently, its goat-milk gelato. The setup is simple: a modest café with a view across the paddocks to the herd, a cheese board built around whatever is ready on the day, and a scoop window running gelato flavours made from the farm's own milk.

It is one of those Peninsula stops where the appeal is directly tied to how small the operation is. You see the paddock. You see the animals. You eat the cheese. The kids understand the whole thing in about thirty seconds. Everybody leaves slightly more informed and slightly better fed. There is no theatre here, just a working dairy that has figured out how to feed visitors without losing its purpose.

A good fifteen-minute detour on a hinterland loop. Pair it with Red Hill Cheese around the corner or a cellar door on the ridge for a proper Peninsula food afternoon.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's most legible farm-to-table stop, you see the animals, you eat the cheese, and the kids understand the whole thing in thirty seconds.
ifOnlyOneThing: Order the cheese board first and finish with a scoop of goat-milk gelato.

worthKnowing.timing: Weekday lunches are quieter; weekends fill early
worthKnowing.lessIdealFor: Those wanting a full restaurant experience — this is a farm café, not a sit-down lunch

seasonalNotes.autumn: The farm setting is at its best when the paddocks are green and the weather turns. One of the quieter Peninsula stops in the cooler months.
seasonalNotes.winter: Fireplace lunches and quieter roads make this one of the better cold-weather Peninsula stops. Pair with a cellar door on the ridge.
seasonalNotes.spring: Kids can often see the goats at closer quarters in spring. Good on a weekday when it's not crowded.
seasonalNotes.summer: Earlier visits work better in summer before the hinterland roads get busy. The gelato is the draw; the cheese boards can wait for cooler weather.
